description: Welcome to your own private retreat just 2 minutes drive to El Ultimo Brinco, a beautiful waterfall in Rincon. This is a great experience if you love the outdoors! 6-8 minutes drive to Pueblo area. Enjoy your own private pool, outdoor kitchen, and peaceful tropical vibes. This stylish container home is perfect for solo travelers or couples looking to relax, surf, and explore the west coast. Includes WiFi, A/C, smart TV, and beach essentials. Unplug, unwind, and soak in the beauty of Puerto Rico.The space🌞 What You’ll Love:💦 Private Pool All to YourselfCool off after a beach day or sip your morning coffee by the water. The pool area is private and peaceful — ideal for sunbathing or night swims under the stars. Please be aware the pool is not heated. The property is just a 2 minute drive to El Ultimo Brinco, which is our only local waterfall in Rincon's beautiful Calvache neighborhood. 🍳 Outdoor Kitchen + Dining AreaCook fresh meals outside in our fully equipped outdoor kitchen with a grill, sink, and prep space. Enjoy your food at the covered dining area with string lights and tropical vibes.🛏️ Cozy, Stylish Living SpaceThis sleek container home includes: • A comfy queen bed with soft linens • A/C and ceiling fan for your ideal temperature • A smart TV and fast WiFi • A compact indoor kitchenette with fridge, microwave, and coffee maker🚿 Spa-Inspired BathroomHot water, plush towels, and locally inspired touches make this a perfect spot to unwind.🌴 Private, Secure & Peaceful PropertyThe home sits on a gated multi-unit property with lush landscaping, parking on site, and plenty of privacy between homes.📍Location, Location, LocationWe’re just a 10-minute drive to downtown Rincón, known for its surf culture, bars, and famous sunsets. The best beaches, restaurants, and local gems are right around the corner.⸻🧼 Extras to Make You Feel at Home: • Beach chairs + towels • Coffee + basic cooking essentials • Outdoor shower to rinse off after the beach • Locally curated guide to help you explore like a local⸻🧳 Perfect For:Solo travelers | Couples | Digital nomads | Surfers | Weekend warriors⸻Whether you’re chasing waves, recharging in the sun, or exploring the west coast of Puerto Rico, Wave Riders Haven is your private slice of paradise.Book your stay and come see why people fall in love with this part of the island 🌊Guest accessThere’s a padlock on the green fence and you will be provided with the combination code before check in.Other things to notePlease note, for this container, the bathroom is located 2 steps outside of the container in a separate indoor room. You will be a short drive away from many local attractions and beautiful beaches in Rincon including: 1. **Domes Beach** - ~10 minutes2. **Rincón Lighthouse (El Faro de Punta Higuero)** - ~10 minutes3. **Steps Beach (Playa Escalera)** - ~12 minutes4. **Sandy Beach** - ~8 minutes5. **Tres Palmas Marine Reserve** - ~12 minutes6. **Black Eagle Beach (Playa La Barca)** - ~10 minutes7. **Rincón Plaza** - ~5 minutes8. **Rincón Art Walk** (weekly event) - ~5 minutes9. **The Black Eagle Beach (Playa La Barca)** - ~10 minutes10. **Desecheo Island** (accessible via boat) - departure points are ~15-20 minutes to the nearest harbor11. Pal Monte restaurant on route 115 is just four minutes drive from the container home of the mountain. Best place for authentic Puerto Rican cuisine.

description: Are you looking for a family apartment near the beach and everything in Rincón, Puerto Rico? This is for you. Comfortable place with a pool. Just at the exit of the center of town and at the main road crossing to the beach. Nearby world famous surf beaches. Convenient location. Within walking distance from the plaza, supermarkets, bakeries, shops, restaurants and food truck parks. Steps away from hotels, bars, banks, churches and others. New space and with private parking. We want to serve you.The spaceIf your destination for a few days is Rincón, Puerto Rico, the Town of Beautiful Sunsets and Capital of Surfing... I have the perfect place for you and yours: a comfortable, elegant and fully equipped apartment in the facilities of Blue Breeze Apartments . Completely private newly created place, recreational patio area with a large pool that you can enjoy and designated parking. Apartment #4 upon entering you find a fully equipped kitchen area with refrigerator, stove, microwave, coffee maker and toaster, utensils, pots, glasses and dishes; dining room in the kitchen area, full bathroom and private room with closet, ironing board, iron, drying rack. It has an area with chairs where you can do work or enjoy your food. All areas with air conditioners.Recreational common area (Patio): Pool, sun loungers around the pool and lounging area under a sun umbrella. A Pergola with additional sitting area and domino table, along with other table games. In addition, there is a small play area for children. Wifi and TVs with live channels included and google tv, so you can access your accounts such as Netflix, Hulu, Prime, Max, Youtube, etc. Retro gaming console included. Fully dressed beds and pillows. The place includes an ironing board with iron. All areas have air conditioning, except the bathrooms. It has a fire extinguisher, smoke detector and first aid kit (with an additional cost of $10, if used). Private parking. The building has a backup power generator. description: Villa las Olas is located at one of the most exclusive complexes in Rincon. Wether you're looking to have a relaxing vacation or have fun doing some water sports, this is the place! Our spacious beach house is good for couples, business travelers, families or group of friends. Beautiful outdoor surroundings, beach views, unforgettable sunsets and much more. Walk to the beach, have a pool day or lounge all day! Located at the heart of Rincon, you'll also want to explore all the beautiful beaches!The spaceThe villa consists of spacious living room, dining room, fully equipped kitchen, family room (with full size sofa bed) and .5 bath located in the 1st floor. The bedrooms are located on the 2nd floor. The master bedroom has a spacious walk-in closet, full bath, California King bed and a balcony with ocean views. The second room has beautiful vaulted ceilings with a King Size bed and beach views. There's also a terrace with chaise lounge chairs to enjoy an amazing view of the sea.At the entrance of the villa you'll find a garden with a shower, following a coffee table umbrella on the 1st floor's private terrace. Central air on the 1st floor and split units in both bedrooms. Fans are also located throughout the villa and all windows have screens in case you'd like to enjoy the sea breeze without being disturbed by mosquitoes.A minimalist decor with white tones to give a sense of spaciousness and brightness. The villa has two assigned parking spaces and amongst its many amenities you can also enjoy cable TV and Wifi. BBQ is also available.Guest accessGuests will have access to the complete villa with a private entrance.

description: We are on the beach where you should be...
